title: Selected proposal folders
slide_intent: Make the development process visible because an identity system depends on testing alternatives before choosing a direction.
strategic_value: The numbered proposal folders can show how Whitney’s graphic language developed through sustained collaboration.
demonstration: Five white proposal folders are stacked diagonally; numbered spines and differently dated covers identify a sequence of work.
practical_value: Distinguish evidence of a design process from evidence that each pictured proposal became a final rule.

content_islands.name: Folder stack
content_islands.spec: Place the overlapping white folders diagonally against the white field; retain numbered spines, dates and studio credits.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows the proposal documents used in the design process, identified by the adjacent caption as sketches and proposals from 2012.
